# Chatbot analytics — HIPAA-minded conversation metrics, token tracking, and dashboards

Curated by Skill Harbor — @curiositech's chatbot-analytics skill: an implementation guide for AI chatbot analytics built around 13 industry-standard metrics (total sessions, messages per session, session duration, engagement, completion, abandonment, response time, token usage, error rate, fallback rate, topic categories, sentiment trend, crisis triggers), with TypeScript tracking patterns for conversation start/exchange/end, metadata-derived category detection (categories derived from AI-response flags, never from content), aggregate SQL queries for session stats, token costs, and category breakdown, alert configurations for crisis/error/abandonment spikes, a conversation_analytics table schema with indexes, and analytics tests. Its signature angle: HIPAA-minded tracking — conversation metadata only, with an explicit list of what must NEVER be stored (message content, user queries, AI responses, health-revealing specifics). Honest caveats: it's engineering guidance, not legal or HIPAA certification — validate compliance yourself; the examples assume a Drizzle-style ORM and a specific schema. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
